Mira (Partnerships): heads up — meeting with CloudSeller next week. they want clarity on how our sampling affects partner invoices. can we draft a short policy?
Jamal (Revenue Ops): yes. main ask is: what sampling thresholds trigger approximate billing vs exact? they saw small monthly deltas ripple to their invoicing.
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): short answer: we sample at ingestion for high-volume connectors when retention < 30d. but we can surface a fidelity flag per payload so partners can opt into exact mode.
Lisette (Billing): opt-in is good but need an audit trail. if a partner later requests a rollback/credit we need request-id -> sampled/expanded mapping for reconciliation.
Alex (Partner Eng): CloudSeller also runs a local aggregator that dedupes on their side. they worry about tombstones: deleted usage rows causing negative deltas when backfilled. any recommended contract language?
Mira (Partnerships): propose: 1) default sampling for >1M events/day, 2) fidelity flag for exact ingest, 3) 90d debug window where we store full raw payloads for replay on request.
Jamal (Revenue Ops): 90d is fine but costs us. can we gate full retention to enterprise partners or dedicated contracts?
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): yes — retention tiering is config-driven. default store (30d aggregated), premium store (90d raw). ops-bot: "store-tier set -> default=30d, premium=90d"
Lisette (Billing): we also need a rollback SLA and a manual reconciliation flow. propose: credits only for verified mismatches that are reproducible with raw replay within the 90d window, and a 30d claim period after invoice issuance.
Alex (Partner Eng): CloudSeller asked about a debug hook — a small endpoint we can call to request a payload replay for specific customer-ids/time ranges. can we expose that to partners?
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): we can add a signed debug-webhook endpoint limited to partner scopes and rate-limited. example curl we can expose:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <signed-token>" https://internal.redwood/api/v1/ingest/replay?partner=cloudseller&start=2026-02-01T00:00Z&end=2026-02-01T01:00Z&customer_id=acct_123
```
Mira (Partnerships): perfect. include an audit header so Billing can verify who initiated replay.
Lisette (Billing): also require a proof-of-claim payload: partner must attach their observed usage file and a short summary of discrepancy. ops will run replay and produce a reconciliation report before credits.
Jamal (Revenue Ops): action items: Jamal draft rollback SLA language + 30d claim window; Lisette draft reconciliation checklist; Sanjay implement signed debug-webhook + retention tiers. deadline EOD Fri?
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): EOD Fri for initial PRs on retention config and webhook prototype. won't ship in prod but code reference and open spec.
Alex (Partner Eng): I'll loop CloudSeller in after we have the webhook spec. will also ask them to simulate tombstone backfill to reproduce their case.
Mira (Partnerships): I'll draft partner-facing one-pager explaining sampling vs fidelity and credit policy.
ops-bot: "task created: #PR-4821 (retention-tiering), #PR-4822 (debug-webhook), #DOC-719 (partner-fidelity-onepager)"
Lisette (Billing): small question: do we annotate each usage event with a sampling_reason tag so audit can show why estimation was used?
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): yes, we'll add metadata fields: sampling=true|false, sampling_reason=(high_throughput|legacy_connector|partner_optout). also attach original_event_count when aggregated.
Mira (Partnerships): ok looks good. final Q: can we support partner-level opt-out from sampling retroactively for a billing period if they pay a surcharge? that's a commercial thing for sales to own but we should note feasibility.
Jamal (Revenue Ops): feasible but requires raw replay for the period and possible credits/adjustments. add to SLA doc as optional paid feature.
Mira (Partnerships): thanks all — I'll collate and share a draft doc in #partnerships by tomorrow morning.
Alex (Partner Eng): thanks, will prep the CloudSeller repro steps. :thumbsup:
Sanjay (Eng-Platform): logging note: make sure replay actions generate a tamper-evident reconciliation.json with checksums. saves dispute time.
Lisette (Billing): agreed. put checksum + signed-timestamp in reports.
ops-bot: "thread closed: policy-draft-in-progress"
